xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5118: pan task done takes one item and commits each time: 48 to 85 acceptance criteria cost 20 to 40 minutes of commit+push loops before a PR

plan.title: pan task done takes one item and commits each time: 48 to 85 acceptance criteria cost 20 to 40 minutes of commit+push loops before a PR
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan task done takes one id and makes one continue commit per call. markItemDone refuses while the corroborating repo is ahead of its upstream, and in a single-repo project the previous call's continue commit makes it ahead, so agents push between calls. Closing 48 to 85 acceptance-criterion sub-items cost 20 to 40 minutes of commit and pre-push hook loops (PAN-5100, PAN-5078).
narratives.Proposal: Replace markItemDone with markItemsDone, which verifies every id's own "Item: <id>" line and the push state of each corroborating repo once, collects every failure, and writes all ids in one continue-file write. pan task done takes <items...> and commits the continue file once; the self route and MCP task_done tool accept itemIds (up to 500). The work prompts tell agents to put the item and its <item>.acN trailer lines on the item commit and close them all in one call. Docs and changelog describe the multi-id form. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5118.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to pan task claim, block, unblock, reopen or cancel, or to the task_claim and task_block tools.
- No new HTTP route and no new pan verb.
- No change to the pan done preflight or its "Incomplete plan items" text.
- No new check that an id exists in the xBRIEF.
- No change to the trailer rule: each id still needs its own exact "Item: <id>" line; parent evidence never covers an AC sub-item.
- No change to how pan task show and pan task next treat AC sub-items.
- No edits to harness-native memory files under ~/.claude/.
- No new Mintlify reference page for pan task.
- No sync twin or wrapper kept beside markItemsDone (markItemDone is removed).
- No change to the stdout tail of any self-job verb other than task-done, and no change to the stderr tail.
- No lint for stale single-id pan task done examples.

autoDecisions.rationale: ls reference/ and git grep over *.mdx find no pan task page; those two files hold the pan task reference text agents and readers use today.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep itemId on POST /api/self/tasks/done and add itemIds capped at 500.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every current caller keeps working, no new route needs a no-loss-matrix row, and 500 covers the largest plan seen (117 AC sub-items on PAN-4223).

autoDecisions.summary: Replace markItemDone with markItemsDone rather than keeping both.
autoDecisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md Key Invariants: one variant per operation in src/lib; only task.ts and two test files call markItemDone.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave the pan done "Incomplete plan items" refusal text unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the change inside the fix the issue lists; the prompts now teach the one-call close.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the existing reason strings (which contain em dashes) for the single-id path.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the single-id form to work unchanged; the no-em-dash rule applies to new doc text.

metadata.sizeJustification: One CLI verb contract (pan task done taking many ids) surfaces in the lib verifier, the CLI, the self route, the MCP tool, the work prompts and the docs. Each surface is a small edit (16 files, about 6 short items), and splitting them into sibling issues would ship a route and tool that send ids the CLI rejects, or prompts that teach a form the CLI lacks.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5118.md work item 1 and decisions D-1, D-2, D-3 exactly. In src/lib/xbrief/continue-state.ts ADD, below markItemDone (lines 358-456, anchor "export async function markItemDone("), MarkItemsDoneOptions { requirePushed; repoRoots? }, the ItemVerificationFailure { kind: "missing-trailer" | "unpushed"; itemIds; reason } type, ItemNotVerifiable(message, failures = []) and markItemsDone(planHome, issueId, itemIds, options) as shown in the PRD After snippet: dedupe ids, find each id's corroborating root via hasTrailerCommit(root, `Item: ${id}`), collect one failure per id without a trailer, run unpushedCommitCount once per corroborating root and collect one failure per unpushed root listing every id it corroborates (catch the no-upstream ItemNotVerifiable into a failure), throw one ItemNotVerifiable with reasons joined by "\n" when any failure exists, otherwise write all ids in one updateContinueState with a shared doneAt and return a Record<id, ContinueItemState>. Keep the existing reason strings byte-identical for one id. Leave markItemDone and MarkItemDoneOptions in place in this item so task.ts still compiles; item cli-variadic-done switches the caller and deletes them. In tests/unit/lib/xbrief/continue-state.test.ts convert every markItemDone call to markItemsDone(planHome, ISSUE, [ITEM], { requirePushed, repoRoots? }) and read results by id, then add the four new real-git tests named in the PRD. Do not touch task.ts in this item.

items.title: Given one pushed commit whose body carries "Item: w1-plan-home", "Item: w1-plan-home.ac1" and "Item: w1-plan-home.ac2", when markItemsDone runs with those three ids, readItemStatuses returns all three as completed and all three doneAt values are equal.

Given a pushed commit that lacks the lines for w1-plan-home.ac2 and w1-plan-home.ac3, when markItemsDone runs with four ids, it rejects with ItemNotVerifiable whose failures itemIds equal [["w1-plan-home.ac2"],["w1-plan-home.ac3"]] and the continue file does not exist.
Given a commit carrying three ids that is not pushed, when markItemsDone runs, it rejects with exactly one failure whose itemIds list all three ids and whose reason contains "ahead of its upstream".
Given [ITEM, ITEM], markItemsDone returns a record with one key, and no test in tests/unit/lib/xbrief/continue-state.test.ts calls markItemDone any more.
